"""Freeze and exercise the local infrastructure candidate without publication."""

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import tomllib
from pathlib import Path
from typing import cast

ROOT = Path("/Users/teilomillet/Code/wyat")
RECEIPT = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/ci-portability-verification.json"
UV = "/Users/teilomillet/.local/bin/uv"
PYTHON = ROOT / ".venv/bin/python"


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def candidates() -> dict[str, str]:
    output = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "ls-files", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z"],
        cwd=ROOT,
    )
    names = sorted(set(output.decode().rstrip("\x00").split("\x00")))
    return {
        name: digest(ROOT / name)
        for name in names
        if ROOT / name != RECEIPT and (ROOT / name).is_file()
    }


def run(command: list[str], timeout: int, env: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, object]:
    result: dict[str, object] = {"command": command, "cap_seconds": timeout}
    started = time.monotonic()
    child = subprocess.Popen(
        command,
        cwd=ROOT,
        env=env,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
        start_new_session=True,
    )
    stdout = stderr = ""
    timed_out = False
    try:
        result["pid"] = child.pid
        try:
            stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            timed_out = True
            try:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            except ProcessLookupError:
                pass
            stdout, stderr = child.communicate()
    finally:
        try:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        except ProcessLookupError:
            pass
        child.wait()
        result.update(
            seconds=time.monotonic() - started,
            exit_code=child.returncode,
            timed_out=timed_out,
            reaped=child.poll() is not None,
            stdout=stdout,
            stderr=stderr,
        )
    return result


def main() -> int:
    if RECEIPT.exists():
        raise FileExistsError(RECEIPT)
    baseline_path = ROOT / "benchmarks/real/api-verification.json"
    baseline = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(baseline_path.read_text()))
    sources = cast(dict[str, str], baseline["source_sha256_after"])
    history = cast(dict[str, str], baseline["historical_evidence_sha256"])
    peer = cast(dict[str, str], baseline["peer_sha256_before"])
    assert all(digest(Path(path)) == expected for path, expected in history.items())
    assert all(digest(Path(path)) == expected for path, expected in peer.items())
    runtime = {
        name: checksum for name, checksum in sources.items() if name.startswith("wyat/")
    }
    assert all(
        digest(ROOT / name) == checksum
        for name, checksum in runtime.items()
        if name != "wyat/backends/kai/mlx.py"
    )
    original_mlx = subprocess.check_output(
        ["git", "show", "4e42b5b:wyat/backends/kai/mlx.py"], cwd=ROOT, text=True
    )
    assert ast.dump(ast.parse(original_mlx), include_attributes=False) == ast.dump(
        ast.parse((ROOT / "wyat/backends/kai/mlx.py").read_text()),
        include_attributes=False,
    )
    archive_path = (
        ROOT
        / "benchmarks/real"
        / "engine-native-projection-verification.sources-d8853ff56034958d.json"
    )
    archive = cast(dict[str, object], json.loads(archive_path.read_text()))
    entries = cast(list[dict[str, str]], archive["files"])
    old_lock = next(entry for entry in entries if entry["name"] == "uv.lock")
    assert old_lock["sha256"] == sources["uv.lock"]
    old = {
        item["name"]: item["version"]
        for item in tomllib.loads(old_lock["text"])["package"]
    }
    current = {
        item["name"]: item["version"]
        for item in tomllib.loads((ROOT / "uv.lock").read_text())["package"]
    }
    assert all(current.get(name) == version for name, version in old.items())
    before = candidates()
    checks: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env.update(
        PYTHONPATH="/Users/teilomillet/Code/dmbench/src",
        MYPYPATH="/Users/teilomillet/Code/dmbench/src",
        MLX_ENABLE_TF32="0",
        HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
        TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
        UV_OFFLINE="1",
        UV_CACHE_DIR="/private/tmp/wyat-uv-build-cache",
    )
    record: dict[str, object] = {
        "completed": False,
        "candidate_sha256_before": before,
        "baseline_receipt_sha256": digest(baseline_path),
        "runtime_baseline_sha256": runtime,
        "runtime_sha256": {name: digest(ROOT / name) for name in runtime},
        "mlx_executable_ast_unchanged": True,
        "initial_hosted_run": {
            "commit": "4e42b5bde18ad1e554d4c44cf666d8e5b1d0017e",
            "url": "https://github.com/teilomillet/wyat/actions/runs/37350508640",
            "conclusion": "failure",
            "linux": "Optional MLX typing unavailable: ten named mypy errors.",
            "macos": "Native types passed; failing tests exceeded 180 seconds.",
        },
        "historical_evidence_sha256": history,
        "peer_sha256": peer,
        "existing_locked_versions_preserved": True,
        "new_locked_packages": {
            name: current[name] for name in current.keys() - old.keys()
        },
        "environment_overrides": {
            name: env[name]
            for name in (
                "PYTHONPATH",
                "MYPYPATH",
                "MLX_ENABLE_TF32",
                "HF_HUB_OFFLINE",
                "TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE",
                "UV_OFFLINE",
                "UV_CACHE_DIR",
            )
        },
        "checks": checks,
        "verifier": {
            "source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
            "sha256": digest(Path(__file__)),
        },
        "remote_execution": (
            "Initial reviewed commit pushed and hosted failure retained; "
            "this follow-up is verified locally before push. No package publication."
        ),
    }
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(
            prefix="wyat-infrastructure-", dir="/private/tmp"
        ) as scratch:
            distributions = Path(scratch) / "dist"
            checkout = Path(scratch) / "checkout"
            for name, checksum in before.items():
                target = checkout / name
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copyfile(ROOT / name, target)
                assert digest(target) == checksum
            plugin = Path("/private/tmp/wyat-ci-portability-37350508640/conftest.py")
            shutil.copyfile(plugin, checkout / "conftest.py")
            record["clean_checkout"] = {
                "candidate_files_copied": len(before),
                "original_results_reads": (
                    "Denied during pytest; current imported dependencies remain real."
                ),
                "deny_plugin_source": plugin.read_text(),
                "deny_plugin_sha256": digest(plugin),
                "excluded": "Ignored local files, model weights, captures, and caches.",
            }
            commands = {
                "lock": ([UV, "lock", "--check", "--offline"], 120),
                "workflows": (
                    [
                        "/opt/homebrew/bin/actionlint",
                        ".github/workflows/ci.yml",
                        ".github/workflows/release.yml",
                    ],
                    60,
                ),
                "quality": (
                    [
                        str(PYTHON),
                        str(checkout / "scripts/checks/main.py"),
                        "--require-metal",
                    ],
                    1600,
                ),
                "build": (
                    [
                        UV,
                        "build",
                        "--offline",
                        "--no-build-isolation",
                        "--out-dir",
                        str(distributions),
                        "--no-create-gitignore",
                        str(ROOT),
                    ],
                    120,
                ),
                "package": (
                    [
                        str(PYTHON),
                        "scripts/package/check.py",
                        str(distributions),
                        "--tag",
                        "v0.0.1",
                    ],
                    1000,
                ),
            }
            for name, (command, cap) in commands.items():
                checks[name] = run(command, cap, env)
                print(json.dumps({"check": name, **checks[name]}), flush=True)
                if checks[name]["exit_code"] or checks[name]["timed_out"]:
                    return 1
            record["distributions"] = {
                path.name: {"sha256": digest(path), "bytes": path.stat().st_size}
                for path in distributions.iterdir()
            }
            record["checksum_manifest"] = (distributions / "SHA256SUMS").read_text()
            record["coverage"] = json.loads(
                (checkout / "artifacts/coverage.json").read_text()
            )
            record["junit_xml"] = (checkout / "artifacts/tests.xml").read_text()
            links = snippets = 0
            for path in (
                ROOT / "README.md",
                ROOT / "CONTRIBUTING.md",
                ROOT / "open-question.md",
                *(ROOT / "docs").rglob("*.md"),
            ):
                source = path.read_text()
                for target in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)", source):
                    if target.startswith(("http:", "https:", "#")):
                        continue
                    assert (path.parent / target.split("#", 1)[0]).resolve().exists(), (
                        path,
                        target,
                    )
                    links += 1
                for snippet in re.findall(r"```python\n(.*?)```", source, re.S):
                    ast.parse(snippet)
                    snippets += 1
            record["markdown"] = {
                "local_links_resolved": links,
                "python_fences_parsed": snippets,
            }
            record["completed"] = True
    except Exception as error:
        record["error"] = {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}
        raise
    finally:
        after = candidates()
        record["candidate_sha256_after"] = after
        record["candidate_unchanged_during_checks"] = before == after
        record["historical_evidence_unchanged"] = all(
            digest(Path(path)) == expected for path, expected in history.items()
        )
        record["peer_unchanged"] = all(
            digest(Path(path)) == expected for path, expected in peer.items()
        )
        if not all(
            record[key]
            for key in (
                "candidate_unchanged_during_checks",
                "historical_evidence_unchanged",
                "peer_unchanged",
            )
        ):
            record["completed"] = False
        with RECEIPT.open("x") as output:
            output.write(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
    return 0 if record["completed"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
